patterns.note: Full-bleed, dark-themed sections with contrasting light text, often featuring large hero images or embedded videos for project showcases.
Use of extremely large, thin, condensed sans-serif typography for impactful, full-screen brand statements and section titles, creating a dramatic visual hierarchy.
Predominantly black background with white text, punctuated by vibrant, saturated accent colors (magenta, blue, green) within imagery and subtle UI elements.

Immersive, scroll-triggered narrative progression, starting with a full-screen text animation, transitioning to a video hero, and then revealing content sections with subtle fade-ins and a persistent background brand element.
Dedicated full-width sections for showcasing individual projects or capabilities, often featuring large hero images or embedded videos that dominate the viewport.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-screen, interactive hero experience that begins with a dynamic text animation, transitions into a video background, and then reveals the main navigation elements as the user scrolls.
Content sections are revealed as the user scrolls, employing a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation effect to introduce new information smoothly.
A persistent, large, semi-transparent brand wordmark is integrated into the background of early content sections, scrolling with the page to reinforce brand identity as content is revealed.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, thin, condensed headings (~8x body) for dramatic impact, paired with a clear, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal rounding on interactive elements like buttons and the menu toggle.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding around content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its highly cinematic and interactive scroll experience, which transforms the homepage into a dynamic, brand-immersive narrative. The initial full-screen text animation and subsequent video hero, combined with the large, semi-transparent brand wordmark integrated into the background, create a unique sense of depth and engagement that goes beyond typical scroll-triggered reveals.
